name: Ensnaring Strike
summary: Wraps a creature you hit in grasping vines that restrain it and deal Piercing damage.

castingTime.trigger: immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon

stats.effect:
As you hit the target, grasping vines appear on it, and it makes a Strength saving throw. A Large or larger creature has {ref:glossary/advantage} on this save. On a failed save, the target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the vines shrivel away, and the spell ends.

While {ref:condition/restrained}, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
